title: Codex skills bundle: install, discovery, invocation, and clean uninstall
prerequisites: Node.js >= 18 and the make-docs CLI built from this repository.
A fresh disposable fixture workspace; the scenario never touches a maintainer working tree.

steps.notes: Disposable fixture workspace (workspacePolicy); all later steps run inside it.
The v2-form source Playbook enters the workspace as ordinary project content.

steps.run: cd "$WORKSPACE" && make-docs run package ship --harness codex --output-kind skills-bundle --surface native --scope project --package-id conformance-skill-probe --json agent/conformance-skill-probe
steps.notes: Run once per targeted tuple: --surface native for codex-skills-bundle-native-project and --surface agents-standard for codex-skills-bundle-agents-standard-project. `ship` runs plan -> preview -> write end-to-end (PRD 41 grammar; --write is retired).

steps.assert: The ship transcript's generated-output records list the bundle files under .agents/skills/conformance-skill-probe/ and the workspace manifest records Make Docs ownership for every generated file.

steps.action: Launch Codex inside the workspace and enumerate Codex's own skills listing surface; confirm conformance-skill-probe appears in the harness's listing, not merely on disk.
In a fresh Codex thread, invoke the conformance-skill-probe skill and capture the transcript.

steps.assert: The invocation transcript contains the probe marker MAKE-DOCS-CONFORMANCE-SKILL-PROBE-OK emitted by the bundled skill.

After removal the generated bundle files and their exposure links are gone, no empty managed directory is orphaned under .agents/skills/, and every user-authored workspace file survives byte-identical.

expectedEvidence: A --json ship transcript recording the generated bundle files and ownership records (install).
The bundle listed by Codex's own listing surface (discover).
A fresh-thread invocation transcript containing MAKE-DOCS-CONFORMANCE-SKILL-PROBE-OK (invoke).
A non-TTY removal transcript plus a workspace diff proving clean uninstall with user files intact (uninstall).
Model, provider, and runtime captured as run metadata in the result record, never embedded in scenario logic.

install: make-docs run package ship exits 0 and its --json transcript records the generated bundle files and manifest ownership inside the disposable workspace.
discover: The generated bundle appears in Codex's own skills listing surface for the workspace — harness listing output, not Make Docs output.
invoke: A fresh Codex thread invokes the bundled skill and the transcript contains the probe marker MAKE-DOCS-CONFORMANCE-SKILL-PROBE-OK.
uninstall: After make-docs setup remove --backup, managed generated outputs are removed, no empty managed directory is orphaned, and user-authored files survive byte-identical.

preconditions.description: The Codex CLI is installed and on PATH.
The Codex CLI is signed in with a working account.
Outbound network access for the harness is available; attested by the operator at run time because probing it would spend it.
The harness can route to a model for the invoke stage; attested by the operator at run time.

futureHarnesses.note: Current product harness; its variant of this scenario follows the Codex-first pass (R-SCEN-1) and is not covered by this spec.
Future harness per R-SCEN-2: no Pi variant exists, and the tuple registry reports that absence explicitly rather than implying coverage.
